scope: throwaway probe package under plugin-packages/ (removed on completion)

tasks.detail: The CLI docs describe event/matcher/command/timeout, same fields as config.toml hooks. Identify a concrete event name before writing the probe; a wrong event name would produce a false negative.
tasks.verify: a named event with its source

tasks.title: Build and install the probe package

tasks.title: Record both verdicts
tasks.detail: Restart Kimi Desktop. Check the hook artifact file. Ask the model for the systemPrompt sentinel. Record fires/does-not-fire with evidence for each — a negative result is a successful outcome for this change.

tasks.title: Remove the probe and update the assessment
tasks.detail: Delete the probe package from plugin-packages/. Update assessment.md E4/E5 from 'unproven' to the measured verdict.
tasks.verify: probe absent; assessment.md reflects the verdict
